label: 그 계명을 교리에 새긴다
success_text: 새 계명이 낭독되자 신전이 숨을 죽입니다.
success_text_en: As the new commandment is read, the temple holds its breath.
fail_text_en: The commandments contradict each other, and the faithful fall into confusion.

label: 꿈은 꿈일 뿐이라고 타이른다
label_en: Remind them a dream is only a dream
success_text: 신도는 고개를 숙이고 돌판 이야기를 접습니다.
success_text_en: The follower bows their head and lets the tablet go.

label: 계명을 함께 해석하는 모임을 연다
label_en: Hold a gathering to interpret it together
success_text: 밤새 이어진 토론 끝에 계명은 더 단단해집니다.
success_text_en: After a night of debate, the commandment grows firmer.
fail_text_en: The gathering breaks up without a conclusion.

label: 본보기로 공개 참회를 시킨다
label_en: Make them repent publicly as an example
success_text: 참회의 울음이 신전을 채우고, 아무도 다시 문 밖을 보지 않습니다.
success_text_en: Wails of repentance fill the temple, and no one looks outside the door again.
fail_text: 벌이 지나치다는 소문이 밖으로 새어 나갑니다.
fail_text_en: Rumors that the punishment went too far leak outside.

label: 조용히 불러 다시 맞아들인다
label_en: Quietly call them back and welcome them
success_text: 그는 눈물을 흘리며 다시는 떠나지 않겠다고 맹세합니다.
success_text_en: They weep and swear never to leave again.
fail_text_en: Your mercy reads as weakness, and whispers linger.

label: 모른 척 넘어간다
success_text: 질투는 가라앉지 않고 마음 한구석에 고입니다.
success_text_en: The jealousy does not settle; it pools in a corner of your heart.

label: 일곱 계율을 새로 선포한다
success_text_en: The seven precepts pass from mouth to mouth.
fail_text_en: Complaints rise that there are too many rules.

label: 표징을 기록만 해 둔다
success_text_en: The record goes deep into the archive.

label: 촛불 앞에서 함께 금식한다
success_text_en: In hunger, the flames gather back into one.
fail_text_en: Several collapse, and the fast is broken.

label: 규칙을 율법으로 높인다
success_text_en: Your name is now spoken only in whispers.
fail_text_en: Outsiders mock the rule.

label: 이름은 부르라고 있는 것이라 말한다
label_en: Say a name is meant to be called
success_text: 거리에서 당신의 이름이 더 자주 들립니다.
success_text_en: Your name is heard more often in the streets.

label: 규칙을 지키는 이들을 축복한다
label_en: Bless those who keep the rule
success_text_en: The blessed stand a little straighter.
fail_text_en: Those left unblessed feel slighted.

label: 구절을 고치고 지난 설교를 거둔다
label_en: Fix the verse and withdraw the old sermons
success_text: 바로잡힌 구절이 오히려 믿음을 단단히 합니다.
success_text_en: The corrected verse only strengthens belief.
fail_text: 신도들이 무엇을 믿어야 할지 모르게 됩니다.
fail_text_en: The faithful no longer know what to believe.

label: 사제를 조용히 물러나게 한다
success_text_en: He is gone, and the verse remains as it was.

label: 두 해석을 모두 인정한다
success_text_en: Two readings lie side by side.
fail_text_en: Neither side is satisfied.

label: 저주를 내린다
success_text: 남은 신도들은 떠난다는 말을 다시 꺼내지 않습니다.
success_text_en: No one remaining speaks of leaving again.
fail_text: 저주 이야기가 신문 한 귀퉁이에 실립니다.
fail_text_en: The story of the curse lands in a corner of the newspaper.

label: 저주 대신 기도를 내린다
label_en: Offer a prayer instead of a curse
success_text_en: The petitioners turn away disappointed.

label: 떠난 자를 잊으라 명한다
label_en: Command them to forget the one who left
success_text_en: The empty seat is soon filled.
fail_text: 잊으라는 말이 오히려 그를 떠올리게 합니다.
fail_text_en: Being told to forget only brings him to mind.

label: 우승자에게 직분을 준다
success_text_en: Recitation goes on late into the night.
fail_text_en: Resentment builds among those who lost.

label: 대회 없이 함께 외운다
success_text_en: The Law rings out in one voice.

label: 외우기보다 지키는 것을 가르친다
label_en: Teach keeping the Law over memorizing it
success_text_en: The faithful begin to live the Law with their hands.
fail_text_en: Some grumble that it was a dull sermon.

label: 그것이 당신의 목소리였다고 말한다
success_text_en: The faithful prostrate themselves before you.
fail_text_en: The voice rings out again, as if mocking you.

label: 목소리의 주인을 찾으라 명한다
label_en: Order them to find the voice's owner
success_text: 아무도 찾지 못합니다. 당신만은 그 주인을 압니다.
success_text_en: No one finds it. Only you know whose it was.

label: 모두와 함께 밤새 기도한다
label_en: Pray through the night with everyone
success_text_en: At dawn, the voice falls silent.
fail_text_en: Everyone is worn out by the vigil.

label: 구절대로 엄히 벌한다
success_text_en: The weight of the Law presses on every shoulder.
fail_text_en: The police loiter outside the temple.

label: 벌 대신 추방한다
success_text_en: Everyone watches the exile walk away.

label: 옛 구절을 비유로 풀어 가르친다
label_en: Teach the verse as a parable
success_text_en: The stones become words that strike the heart.
fail_text_en: Those who wanted severity are disappointed.

label: 십일조를 율법으로 정한다
success_text_en: The offering box fills heavily.
fail_text_en: A few poor followers leave.

label: 원하는 이만 바치게 한다
success_text_en: The hands that give are light.

label: 바친 것을 가난한 신도에게 나눈다
label_en: Share the offerings with the poor faithful
success_text: 받은 이들이 가장 큰 소리로 찬송합니다.
success_text_en: Those who receive sing loudest of all.
fail_text_en: The ledgers tangle and you lose money.

label: 서명한다
success_text: 약속대로 금고가 불어납니다. 사내는 장부에 무언가를 적습니다.
success_text_en: As promised, the vault swells. The man writes something in his ledger.
fail_text: 계약서의 작은 글씨가 당신의 금고를 비웁니다.
fail_text_en: The fine print empties your vault.

label: 계약서를 찢는다
success_text: 사내는 웃으며 다음에 또 오겠다고 합니다.
success_text_en: The man smiles and says he will come again.

label: 조건을 하나씩 따져 묻는다
success_text: 당신은 손해 보지 않을 만큼만 서명합니다.
success_text_en: You sign only as much as costs you nothing.
fail_text_en: The more you ask, the more clauses appear.

label: 장부를 받아 모두 앞에서 읽는다
success_text: 이름이 불릴 때마다 누군가 고개를 떨굽니다.
success_text_en: Each time a name is read, someone lowers their head.
fail_text_en: Suspicious glances fill the temple.

label: 장부를 불태운다
success_text: 재가 된 장부 위로 안도의 한숨이 흐릅니다.
success_text_en: Sighs of relief drift over the ashes.

label: 장부를 몰래 간직한다
success_text_en: Your drawer grows a little heavier.
fail_text_en: Word of the ledger leaks out.

label: 시험을 내리고 걸린 재산을 받는다
label_en: Set the test and take the stake
success_text: 상인은 시험에 졌고, 그 재산은 당신의 것이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The merchant fails, and his fortune becomes yours.
fail_text_en: The merchant sues, claiming fraud.

label: 시험은 재산으로 하는 것이 아니라 말한다
label_en: Say tests are not for wealth
success_text_en: Moved, the merchant praises you to his neighbors.

label: 작은 시험만 내린다
success_text_en: A small offering arrives quietly.
fail_text_en: Preparing the test only costs money.

label: 한쪽을 골라 다른 쪽을 내친다
label_en: Pick a side and cast out the other
success_text_en: The remaining officers watch your face carefully.
fail_text_en: The ones cast out take followers with them.

label: 둘 다 벌한다
success_text_en: The quarrel ends, but the temple grows cold.

label: 서로의 죄를 용서하게 한다
success_text_en: The two reluctantly clasp hands.
fail_text_en: The forgiveness is only words; the feud goes on.

label: 그 기적을 팔아 봉헌금을 모은다
success_text_en: Lines to buy the bread fill the alley.
fail_text: 빵이 다시 돌이 되었다는 항의가 쏟아집니다.
fail_text_en: Complaints pour in that the bread turned back to stone.

label: 헛소리라며 입을 막는다
success_text: 그는 입을 다물고, 돌은 돌로 남습니다.
success_text_en: He falls silent, and the stones stay stones.

label: 굶는 이들에게 진짜 빵을 나눈다
label_en: Share real bread with the hungry
success_text: 진짜 빵이 가짜 기적보다 멀리 퍼집니다.
success_text_en: Real bread travels farther than a false miracle.
fail_text_en: The bread costs money and earns no gratitude.

label: 넉넉히 쥐여 준다
success_text_en: The paperwork is quietly handled.
fail_text: 그가 다른 사건으로 잡혀 당신의 이름을 말합니다.
fail_text_en: He is arrested on another case and gives your name.

label: 정식 절차를 밟는다
success_text_en: The permit comes slowly, but clean.

label: 그의 약점을 쥐고 협상한다
success_text_en: He is your man now.
fail_text_en: He reports you first.

label: 금화를 녹여 제단을 꾸민다
label_en: Melt it to adorn the altar
success_text_en: The altar shines gold.
fail_text: 제단에서 밤마다 쇠 긁는 소리가 납니다.
fail_text_en: Every night the altar makes a sound like scraping metal.

label: 금화의 주인을 찾는다
success_text_en: The owner never appears.

label: 금화를 강물에 던진다
label_en: Throw the coin into the river
success_text_en: The river swallows the coin and falls quiet.

label: 고발을 받아 대가를 정한다
label_en: Hear the accusations and set penalties
success_text_en: Your verdicts become the neighborhood's law.
fail_text_en: The neighbors report the cult to the authorities.

label: 남의 죄보다 제 죄를 보라 한다
label_en: Tell them to look at their own sins
success_text_en: The line quietly disperses.

label: 고발 대신 화해의 자리를 만든다
success_text_en: Neighbors and followers sit at one table.
fail_text_en: Instead of reconciling, voices only rise.

label: 판을 연다
success_text: 주사위가 구를 때마다 당신의 이름이 불립니다.
success_text_en: Your name is called with every roll of the dice.
fail_text_en: A police raid bursts in.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: The owner clicks his tongue and leaves.

label: 한 번만 열고 닫는다
success_text: 한 번의 판으로 금고가 조금 찹니다.
success_text_en: One night of play fills the vault a little.
fail_text_en: Even once is enough for rumors.

label: 엎드린 자들에게 왕국을 약속한다
success_text_en: Cheers shake the temple.
fail_text_en: The promise weighs on your shoulders.

label: 일어나라 명한다
success_text_en: The faithful rise, bewildered.

label: 꿈의 의미를 함께 묵상한다
success_text_en: The reading that remains: the dream was a test.
fail_text_en: The dream stays unsolved and returns each night.

label: 광장에서 더 많은 이의 눈을 만진다
label_en: Touch more eyes in the square
success_text: 눈을 뜬 이들이 당신의 이름을 외칩니다.
success_text_en: Those whose eyes open shout your name.
fail_text: 아무도 눈을 뜨지 못하자 야유가 터집니다.
fail_text_en: When no one else sees, jeers break out.

label: 아이만 데리고 조용히 떠난다
success_text: 아이의 부모가 그날 밤 신전을 찾아옵니다.
success_text_en: That night, the child's parents come to the temple.

label: 빛은 마음에 있다고 설교한다
label_en: Preach that the light is in the heart
success_text_en: People in the square nod.
fail_text_en: Those hoping for a miracle are let down.

label: 모임을 의식으로 삼는다
success_text_en: The scent of herbs wraps the temple.
fail_text_en: One follower is rushed to the hospital.

label: 약초를 금한다
success_text_en: The circle breaks up, leaving resentment.

label: 약초 대신 단식으로 바꾼다
success_text: 맑아진 머리로 그들은 천사를 다시 그립니다.
success_text_en: With clearer heads, they picture the angel anew.
fail_text_en: The fast runs long and some collapse.

label: 소문을 부풀려 마을 사람을 받아들인다
label_en: Feed the rumor and take in the townsfolk
success_text_en: People crowd the temple doors.
fail_text: 교단 안에서도 기침 소리가 들리기 시작합니다.
fail_text_en: Coughing begins inside the cult as well.

label: 소문을 바로잡는다
success_text_en: A few, drawn by your honesty, come anyway.

label: 환자를 돌보는 이들을 보낸다
label_en: Send people to tend the sick
success_text_en: Those you cared for become followers.
fail_text_en: Even the caretakers fall ill.

label: 그 신도를 천사의 선택이라 선포한다
label_en: Proclaim them chosen by the angel
success_text_en: The faithful revere the fallen one.
fail_text_en: The faithful dread the next name.

label: 쓰러진 신도를 돌본다
success_text_en: After three days, they open their eyes.

label: 꿈을 입 밖에 내지 않는다
success_text_en: The serpent's whisper becomes your burden alone.

label: 행렬을 매주 연다
success_text_en: The procession grows longer each week.
fail_text_en: Complaints about blocked traffic pour in.

label: 행렬을 멈추게 한다
success_text_en: The streets grow quiet again.

label: 행렬 끝에서 눈을 풀어 준다
label_en: Unbind their eyes at the end
success_text: 붕대를 푼 눈들이 당신을 처음 봅니다.
success_text_en: Unbound eyes see you for the first time.
fail_text_en: It was not as moving as hoped.

label: 시험을 허락한다
success_text_en: The faith of the survivors is iron-hard.
fail_text_en: Someone collapses, and an ambulance comes.

label: 간부를 꾸짖는다
success_text: 간부는 고개를 숙이지만 눈빛은 꺾이지 않습니다.
success_text_en: The officer bows, but their eyes do not.

label: 두 잔 모두 꿀물로 바꿔 둔다
label_en: Secretly fill both cups with honey
success_text_en: Everyone survives, and everyone calls it a miracle.

label: 기적을 약속하고 입교시킨다
label_en: Promise a miracle and induct them
success_text_en: The patient rises and walks, as if by miracle.
fail_text: 환자가 세상을 떠나고 가족이 등을 돌립니다.
fail_text_en: The patient dies, and the family turns away.

label: 함께 기도만 해 준다
success_text_en: The family thanks you and takes your hand.

label: 남은 시간을 평안히 보내게 돕는다
label_en: Help them spend the time in peace
success_text: 마지막 날까지 그 방에는 찬송이 흐릅니다.
success_text_en: Hymns fill that room until the last day.
fail_text_en: The grief settles on you as well.

label: 금빛 눈을 보여 주는 의식을 연다
label_en: Hold a rite to reveal the golden eyes
success_text: 어둠 속에서 두 개의 금빛이 떠오릅니다.
success_text_en: Two golden lights rise in the dark.
fail_text_en: The eyes in the mirror stare back at you.

label: 불빛을 잘못 본 것이라 한다
success_text_en: The sightings die down.

label: 눈을 감고 지낸다
success_text: 어둠 속에서 몸 안의 눈동자도 잠잠합니다.
success_text_en: In the dark, the eyes within you are quiet too.
fail_text_en: You stumble walking with your eyes shut.

label: 천사의 벌이라고 경고한다
label_en: Warn that it is the angel's punishment
success_text_en: Those about to leave unpack their bags.
fail_text_en: Suspicion of poisoning turns toward the cult.

label: 떠난 이들에게 약을 보낸다
label_en: Send medicine to those who left
success_text_en: A few send letters of thanks.
fail_text_en: The medicine is returned; only the cost remains.

label: 아무 말도 하지 않는다
success_text_en: Silence only feeds the rumor.

label: 그 말을 인정한다
success_text_en: The baptized look at the world differently.
fail_text_en: A newly baptized follower collapses and an uproar follows.

label: 거짓이라 선포한다
success_text_en: The young followers pout.

label: 독 대신 쓴 쑥을 넣게 한다
success_text_en: The bitterness alone is enough to make them tremble.
fail_text_en: They find it tame.

label: '나 외에 다른 건축가는 없다'고 말한다
label_en: Declare 'There is no builder but me'
success_text_en: An odd silence mixes into the applause.
fail_text_en: The papers call you arrogant.

label: 일꾼들의 공으로 돌린다
success_text_en: The workers lift their heads with pride.

label: 상금을 이웃에 기부한다
label_en: Donate the prize to the neighbors
success_text_en: News of the donation travels farther than the speech.
fail_text_en: The donation paperwork gets tangled.

label: 깃발을 신전 꼭대기에 건다
success_text_en: The lion face looks down on the neighborhood.
fail_text_en: The bizarre banner becomes a local spectacle.

label: 깃발을 창고에 넣는다
success_text_en: The officers are disappointed.

label: 깃발 대신 흙으로 빚은 상을 세운다
success_text_en: The scent of clay seeps into the temple.
fail_text_en: The statue cracks and must be molded again.

label: 의식을 공개 시연한다
success_text_en: The clay figure's finger twitches.
fail_text_en: The figure crumbles, and you become a joke.

label: 의식서를 봉인한다
success_text_en: The sealed book grows a little warmer every night.

label: 신도들끼리 조용히 해 보게 한다
label_en: Let the followers try it quietly
success_text_en: They will not say what they saw.
fail_text_en: Nothing happens.

label: 일곱 아르콘으로 세운다
success_text: 일곱 구역에 일곱 개의 작은 왕좌가 생깁니다.
success_text_en: Seven small thrones appear in seven districts.
fail_text_en: The districts start fighting each other.

label: 모든 결정은 당신이 한다
success_text_en: Papers pile up like a mountain on your desk.

label: 한 명씩 차례로 맡긴다
label_en: Entrust them one at a time
success_text_en: Order slowly takes hold.
fail_text_en: Those waiting grow impatient.

label: 카메라 앞에서 세상을 빚겠다고 말한다
label_en: Tell the camera you will mold the world
success_text: 방송이 나간 뒤 문의 전화가 빗발칩니다.
success_text_en: After the broadcast, the phones ring nonstop.
fail_text: 편집된 화면 속 당신은 광인처럼 보입니다.
fail_text_en: In the edited footage you look like a madman.

label: 서면으로만 답한다
success_text_en: A short article runs quietly.

label: 봉사 현장만 찍게 한다
label_en: Let them film only your charity work
success_text_en: A heartwarming clip spreads.
fail_text_en: Comments call it staged.

label: 석상을 신전 중앙에 모신다
label_en: Enshrine it at the temple's center
success_text_en: The faithful kneel before the statue.
fail_text_en: Each night the statue's eyes follow you.

label: 박물관에 기증한다
success_text_en: Citizens applaud the donation.

label: 다시 묻는다
success_text_en: Something beneath the soil grows still.

label: 공사를 밀어붙인다
success_text_en: The walls rise, and so does the resentment.
fail_text_en: A stop-work order comes down.

label: 공사를 멈추고 사과한다
success_text_en: The neighbors' faces soften.

label: 마을에 우물을 함께 파 준다
label_en: Dig a well for the town
success_text_en: Talk of the cult passes around the well.
fail_text_en: No water comes up.

label: 문구를 금으로 새긴다
success_text: 금빛 문구가 지나는 이들을 멈춰 세웁니다.
success_text_en: The golden words stop passersby in their tracks.

fail_text_en: Other religious groups issue statements of protest.

label: 안건을 부결한다
success_text_en: The entrance stays plain.

label: 작은 글씨로 안쪽에만 새긴다
label_en: Carve it small, on the inside
success_text_en: Only those who enter see the words.
fail_text: 보는 이가 없어 의미가 없다는 말이 나옵니다.
fail_text_en: Some say it is pointless if no one sees it.

label: 졸업생들에게 교단의 뜻을 따르게 한다
label_en: Have them follow the cult's will
success_text: 시청의 결정이 교단의 뜻과 닮아 갑니다.
success_text_en: City hall's decisions begin to resemble the cult's will.
fail_text_en: A collusion scandal breaks.

label: 학교는 학교로 둔다
label_en: Let the school be a school
success_text_en: The school's good name becomes the cult's.

label: 장학금을 늘린다
success_text_en: Poor students knock on the cult's door.
fail_text_en: The money goes out and nothing comes back.

label: 산은 그 자리에 있어야 한다고 답한다
label_en: Say the mountain belongs where it is
success_text_en: The faithful chew on those words for a long time.

label: 산 대신 산을 닮은 제단을 쌓는다
label_en: Build an altar shaped like a mountain

fail_text_en: The altar is stacked crooked.

label: 그 앎을 신도들에게 전한다
label_en: Share the knowing with the faithful
success_text: 신도들은 이해하지 못한 채 고개를 끄덕입니다.
success_text_en: The faithful nod without understanding.

label: 앎을 가슴에 묻어 둔다
label_en: Bury the knowing in your heart
success_text: 아무도 모르는 진실이 당신을 단단하게 합니다.
success_text_en: A truth no one else knows makes you harder.

label: 야훼의 이름으로 문을 연다
label_en: Open the gate in Yahweh's name
success_text: 문이 열리고, 문지기들이 당신에게 고개를 숙입니다.
success_text_en: The gate opens, and the gatekeepers bow to you.
fail_text_en: A gatekeeper's claws rake across the vessel.

label: 그들의 이름을 하나씩 불러 지나간다
label_en: Name each of them and pass
success_text_en: Named, the Archons step aside.
fail_text_en: You forget one name and must go the long way.

label: 그 고요를 오래 붙든다
label_en: Hold the silence as long as you can
success_text_en: The eyes within you close for a while.

label: 고요를 깨고 더 위로 오른다
label_en: Break the silence and climb higher
success_text_en: The silence breaks, and the eyes open again.

label: 그렇다고 답한다
success_text: 그림자는 웃으며 당신의 그림자 속으로 스며듭니다.
success_text_en: The shadow smiles and seeps into your own shadow.

label: 아직 모르겠다고 답한다
label_en: Answer that you do not know yet
success_text_en: The shadow whispers that it will wait.

label: 왕좌를 향해 손을 뻗는다
success_text_en: The throne's chill climbs up your fingertips.
